paper_title: Particle dispersion in the classical vector dark matter background
suggested_experiment_name: Dark photon DM compilation (DPDM + Sun/HB/RG + NS/SN1987A + BHSR)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (chi), dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Theoretical paper deriving constraints on light gauge boson (dark photon, Lmu-Ltau, B-L) models from particle dispersion/normalization effects in a classical vector dark matter background. For the dark photon model (Fig. 6) two bounds apply: electron-mass measurement (Eq. 35, g_e < 3.3e-12 (m/1e-20 eV)) and electroweak-precision/normalization (Eq. 39, g_e < 6.6e-39 (m/1e-20 eV)^2). The emitted points are the stronger normalization (Z) line converted to kinetic mixing epsilon; both are mass-dependent power-law lines derived from analytic formulas, not a table. Coupling type is DarkPhoton (epsilon) for Fig. 6, but the paper also covers Lmu-Ltau and B-L models, hence reduced confidence.
